author: LadyLeigh
name: TwitchBridge
short: Twitch connections, shared commands, announcements and chat logs.
description: Owner-controlled broadcaster linking, device authorization, EventSub logging, standalone custom commands shared with Discord, and plain-text announcements.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Twitch broadcaster IDs, usernames, OAuth tokens and Discord channel settings. Copies Twitch messages to configured Discord channels; no local chat archive is kept.
